question: Who among the following was elected as the first-ever President of Barbados to replace Britain's Queen Elizabeth in October 2021, with a two-thirds vote during a joint session of the country's House of Assembly and Senate?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sandra Mason**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Barbados has elected its first-ever president to replace Britain's Queen Elizabeth as the Caribbean island's head of state, marking a significant step toward shedding the island's colonial past.
 
• Sandra Mason was chosen by a two-thirds vote of the country's House of Assembly and Senate.
 
• Barbados is a former British colony that gained independence in 1966 and had long maintained ties with the British monarchy. But calls for full sovereignty and homegrown leadership have risen in recent years.
 
• Sandra Mason will be sworn in on Nov 30 which is the country’s 55th anniversary of independence from Britain.
 
• Mason is a former jurist who has been governor-general of the island since 2018, she was also the first woman to serve on the Barbados Court of Appeals.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **About Barbados:**

 
 
• Barbados is an island country in the Lesser Antilles of the West Indies which is in the** Caribbean region of North America.**
 
• **Capital: **Bridgetown
 
• **Currency:** Barbados Dollar
 
• **Continent:** North America
